remarks:
INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY directly across from the University at Buffalo South Campus! 315 Winspear Ave offers investors multiple potential income strategies in an exceptionally convenient location. Currently configured as a single-family residence and rented by the room, the property provides the opportunity to continue its current rental model, operate as a traditional single-family rental, or explore conversion to a two-family investment property.

The home already features separate electric panels and kitchens for the upper and lower levels, along with plumbing infrastructure for simple addition of a second gas meter. A concrete driveway and two-car garage offer valuable off-street parking with room for multiple vehicles.

Major updates include a new hot water tank in 2025, new vinyl replacement windows, a new roof in 2018, and a newer furnace. No need to budget for big ticket upgrades. Appliances are included as well.

With UB South Campus directly across the street and convenient access to public transportation, shopping, dining, and surrounding city amenities, this property is well positioned for continued rental demand. 

Whether you’re looking to add a strategically located rental to your portfolio, explore a potential two-unit configuration, or owner-occupy while generating rental income, 315 Winspear is a solid option.
